2608.24809.title: Structurally-bounded Agentic Graph Exploration for Evidence-Grounded Scholarly DeepSearch
2608.24809.paper_summary: We present Crase, a bounded and inspectable alternative to deep research agents for scholarly search. Instead of an open-ended search loop, Crase queries a search engine once for seed papers, expands them along their 1.5-hop citation neighborhood, prunes citation edges whose claims lack entailment support, and ranks the remaining papers with a recency-aware random walk. This makes the candidate set, the reason each paper is kept, and the stopping condition explicit and fixed before inference. On LitSearch and one further benchmarks over a 500K-paper arXiv corpus, Crase outperforms deep research agents built on proprietary models by up to 3$\times$ recall@50 at roughly a third of the cost.
2608.24809.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了 Crase，一種有界且可檢查的替代方案，用於學術搜尋中的深度研究代理。Crase 不是一個無限的搜尋循環，而是一次性查詢搜索引擎以獲取種子論文，然後沿著它們的 1.5 跳引文鄰域進行擴展，修剪缺乏推導支持的引文邊緣，並用一種考慮時效性的隨機漫步對剩餘的論文進行排名。這使得候選集、每篇論文被保留的理由以及停止條件在推理之前都是明確且固定的。在 LitSearch 和另外一個基準測試中，基於 500K 論文的 arXiv 資料庫，Crase 的表現超過了基於專有模型構建的深度研究代理，回憶率在 50 的情況下提高了多達 3$\times$，而成本大約只有三分之一。
